Class TurnOrderTile

java.lang.Object
model.board.TurnOrderTile
public class TurnOrderTile extends Object
Manages the turn order tile component of the board. The turn order tile contains a sequence of slots where players' totems are placed at the start and after completing their actions. Each slot may provide food bonuses or penalties when the totem lands on it. The tile is responsible for coordinating totem placement, applying slot effects, and tracking the turn order.

  • Method Details

    • freeSlot

      public void freeSlot(Player player)
      Clears the slot currently occupied by the given player, freeing it for future use. This method is called when a player moves their totem from the turn order tile to the offer track.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose slot is to be cleared

    • returnTotemAndResolveEffects

      public void returnTotemAndResolveEffects(Player player)
      Returns a player's totem to the turn order tile on the first available free slot and resolves the slot's effects. Places the player on the first free slot in order, updates their location, and applies the slot's effect (which may include food bonuses or penalties). This is called at the end of a player's action turn.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose totem is being returned
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if no free slot is available
      See Also:
      • TurnOrderSlot.applyEffect()

    • disconnectedReturnTotemAndResolveEffects

      public void disconnectedReturnTotemAndResolveEffects(Player player)
      Returns a player's totem to the turn order tile on the last available free slot and resolves the slot's effects. This variant is used when a player disconnects. Places the player on the last free slot instead of the first, updates their location, and applies the slot's effect. This may result in different game consequences than the standard return flow.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose totem is being returned
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if no free slot is available
      See Also:
      • TurnOrderSlot.applyEffect()

    • getFirstFreeSlot

      private TurnOrderSlot getFirstFreeSlot()
      Finds the first free slot on the turn order tile. Searches the list of slots in order and returns the first unoccupied slot.
      Returns:
      the first free TurnOrderSlot
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if no free slot is found

    • getLastFreeSlot

      private TurnOrderSlot getLastFreeSlot()
      Finds the last free slot on the turn order tile. Searches the list of slots and returns the final unoccupied slot. Used when a player disconnects to apply a different turn order outcome.
      Returns:
      the last free TurnOrderSlot
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if no free slot is found

    • getTurnOrder

      public List<Player> getTurnOrder()
      Returns the list of players in turn order based on their slot positions. Constructs a list containing all players currently occupying slots, in the order that their slots appear on the turn order tile.
      Returns:
      a list of Players in turn order
